rationale: Third candidate reading of rule 1, stated as its own vector so it is not lost in the pair: an implementation that treats a card lacking REQUIRED fields as non-conformant refuses it rather than picking a byte string. This is a serializer/signer-side refusal and cannot be produced by either canonicalization reading above; it is included because the spec sentence "REQUIRED fields MUST always be present" can also be read as a validation obligation on the input.
